title: La indirecta
desc: A leaking roof, mentioned like the weather
setting: Doña Elena has been in your yard for an hour talking about the heat, the gas and her leg.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Y ahí el techo de la cocina goteando desde mayo.
steps.en: And there is the kitchen roof, leaking since May.

options.feedback: She has thrown it and changed the subject. Answering inside the same minute would tell her you heard a request, which is what she is avoiding.
Sympathy, which is not what she came for. It leaves the hint on the floor.

options.en: Do you want me to fix it for you?
options.feedback: Naming it as a request forces her to admit she asked, which is the whole thing she was protecting.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Pero bueno. ¿Y el chavalito, cómo va?
steps.en: Anyway. And the boy, how is he?

options.es: Bien, ya camina. (y seguir con eso)
options.en: Well, he is walking now. (and go on with that)
options.feedback: You followed her off the subject. The roof stays where she left it, which is where it is supposed to stay.

options.es: Bien. Volviendo a lo del techo...
options.en: Well. Going back to the roof...
options.feedback: Dragging it back turns her hint into a negotiation.

options.en: Well. And how long has it been leaking?
options.feedback: Investigating the hint is the same as answering it out loud.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: (una hora después) Bueno, ya me voy.
steps.en: (an hour later) Right, I am off.

options.es: Doña, el domingo ando por allá. Llevo la escalera.
options.en: Doña, I am over your way on Sunday. I will bring the ladder.
options.feedback: Offered as your own idea, at the gate, an hour later. That is the answer to an indirecta and it is word-perfect.

options.es: Yo le puedo ayudar con el techo.
options.en: I can help you with the roof.
options.feedback: The right offer, said too plainly. It tells her the hint was received as a request.

options.es: Entonces el domingo le arreglo lo que me pidió.
options.en: So on Sunday I will fix what you asked me for.
options.feedback: She asked for nothing. Saying she did takes the whole thing apart.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Ay, no se moleste, mijo. Después.
steps.en: Oh, do not trouble yourself, son. Another time.

options.es: Si ya voy para allá, doña. Ahí le doy un vistazo.
options.en: I am going that way anyway, doña. I will take a look.
options.feedback: She refused once, which is obligatory. You insisted once, which is also obligatory. Now it is agreed.

options.en: All right, another time if you like.
options.feedback: You took the ritual refusal as a real one. The roof will still be leaking in October.
Same thing, with the door shut behind it.
